uncertainty: 4000 deterministic bootstrap resamples of matched pair blocks; 95% percentile interval for geometric tuned/generic ratio. Only 4 pairs by default: exploratory, not a population/hardware guarantee. Both JP2/J2K encodings of each source are correlated, not 16 independent images.
memory: KiB. GNU time max_process_rss is maximum single-process RSS in the tree. Decode RSS includes startup, input and post-timing sample hashing. Build summed-tree RSS sampled every 50ms can miss peaks and double-count shared pages.
link_time: Native cc linker invocation wall time, including wrapper overhead. LLVM ThinLTO optimization runs inside rustc before native link; rustc invocation wall time is retained separately; neither is pure LLVM link-only time.
